title: The functor between two categories of $\mathbb{Z}-$graded manifolds
summary: This paper examines $\mathbb{Z}$-graded manifolds as semiformal homogeneity structures, comparing two polynomial filtrations from their local models. In finite dimensions, these are componentwise equivalent, yielding isomorphic graded completions; generally, one induces a finer topology. By the Batchelor-Gawedzki-type theorem (Kotov--Salnikov), every $\mathbb{Z}$-graded manifold over base $M$ is noncanonically isomorphic to one associated with its canonical $\mathbb{Z}$-graded bundle (Batchelor-Gawedzki bundle).
